jobId.title: Job ID
jobId.description: The unique LinkedIn job posting ID.

title.title: Job Title
title.description: The advertised title of the job.

company.title: Company Name
company.description: Name of the company that posted the job.

companyUrl.title: Company URL
companyUrl.description: URL of the company's LinkedIn page.

companyLogo.title: Company Logo
companyLogo.description: Direct URL to the company's logo image.

location.title: Location
location.description: Raw location text as shown on the job card.

locationParsed.title: Parsed Location
locationParsed.description: Location split into city, state, country and raw text.

salary.title: Salary
salary.description: Parsed salary object with min, max, currency, period and raw text. Null when the posting lists no salary.

postedDate.title: Date Posted
postedDate.description: When the job was posted, as an ISO date or LinkedIn's relative text.

jobUrl.title: Job URL
jobUrl.description: Canonical URL of the job posting, with tracking parameters stripped.

scrapedAt.title: Scraped At
scrapedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the record was scraped.

description.title: Description
description.description: Full job description as plain text. Requires Deep Scrape: Job Details.

descriptionHtml.title: Description HTML
descriptionHtml.description: Full job description with original HTML markup. Requires Deep Scrape: Job Details.

seniorityLevel.title: Seniority Level
seniorityLevel.description: Seniority as listed in LinkedIn's job criteria.

employmentType.title: Employment Type
employmentType.description: Employment type as listed in LinkedIn's job criteria.

jobFunction.title: Job Function
jobFunction.description: Job function as listed in LinkedIn's job criteria.

industries.title: Industries
industries.description: Industries as listed in LinkedIn's job criteria.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Required skills or qualifications extracted from the posting.

applicants.title: Applicants
applicants.description: Applicant count text, when LinkedIn exposes one.

easyApply.title: Easy Apply
easyApply.description: True when the posting uses LinkedIn Easy Apply.

applyUrl.title: Apply URL
applyUrl.description: Link to the application, which may point to an external site.

detailScrapeFailed.title: Detail Scrape Failed
detailScrapeFailed.description: True when only listing data was saved because the detail page could not be fetched.

type.title: Record Type
type.description: Set to COMPANY on company records. Absent on job records.

companyId.title: Company ID
companyId.description: Numeric LinkedIn company ID. Present on company records only.

name.title: Company Name
name.description: Company name. Present on company records only.

industry.title: Industry
industry.description: Company industry. Present on company records only.

companySize.title: Company Size
companySize.description: Employee count range. Present on company records only.

website.title: Website
website.description: Company website. Present on company records only.

details.title: Job details
details.description: Fields available when Deep Scrape: Job Details is enabled.
